rationale: For the extra-coverage firms where oancf is missing, the accrual gate collapses algebraically to NEG(ΔWC − dp) = dp − ΔWC, so the "earnings convert to cash" gate silently becomes a depreciation-intensity gate on precisely the subsample the signal is meant to add — an internal inconsistency layered on what is otherwise a mechanical merge of two already-evaluated specifications.

A defensible refinement of the archived TwoCornerIntangibleAccountingSpread that swaps the short corner's pre-R&D profitability screen for a pre-R&D cash-burn screen, but the two conjuncts of that corner (high ib−oancf and low oancf+xrd) are largely the same low-oancf condition, so the "independent certifications" framing is weaker than claimed and the spread risks becoming a cash-flow bet.

Sign and construction are internally consistent and standalone evaluation of the short corner has genuine attribution value, but the accrual conjunct and the cash-burn conjunct are mechanically correlated (both driven by low oancf), making this closer to a redundant double-count of the archived accrual-plus-intangible short leg than to a three-way screen.

The MIN-versus-additive structural question is legitimate, but the expression reduces to an unweighted linear composite of two long-known standalone predictors (R&D-to-assets and cash-flow-to-assets) with no interaction content, so it is a low-information mechanical check rather than a cross-theme signal.

Rescaling the intangible stock by the visible-plus-invisible equity base asks a genuinely different economic question than asset scaling and the bounded [0,1] form legitimately defuses the negative-equity sign flip, though ABS(ceq) still pushes distressed negative-equity firms toward the top of the bet leg and should be monitored as a distress contaminant.

This is a rediscovery of the gen-0 AcquiredIntangibleAccrualInflation (same two ingredients — balance-sheet working-capital accruals interacted with the annual change in capitalized intangibles — with MIN substituted for MUL and gdwl folded in), and the stated "level versus flow" motivation misdescribes the archived signal, which already used the change.
